1→# Fix Drop Indicator: Position-Aware Placement (Part 2)
     2→
     3→## Context
     4→The `useDroppable` was added to `QuestionCard`, but items are still being added at the end. Investigation revealed TWO issues:
     5→
     6→1. **Backend doesn't shift existing questions** - The `create` procedure just inserts with the provided `order` value without shifting existing questions.
     7→2. **Frontend appends to end** - The `onSuccess` callback does `[...prev, newQuestion]` which always appends.
     8→
     9→## Root Cause
    10→
    11→### Backend (question.ts:107-130)
    12→```tsx
    13→create: adminProcedure
    14→    .input(questionCreateSchema)
    15→    .handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
    16→        // Just inserts with input.order - NO shifting of existing questions!
    17→        await db.insert(question).values({
    18→            order: input.order,  // <-- Just uses this value as-is
    19→        });
    20→    }),
    21→```
    22→
    23→### Frontend (index.tsx:147-159)
    24→```tsx
    25→const createMutation = useMutation({
    26→    onSuccess: (newQuestion) => {
    27→        setQuestions((prev) => [...prev, newQuestion]);  // <-- APPENDS to end!
    28→    },
    29→});
    30→```
    31→
    32→## Solution
    33→
    34→### Option A: Update Frontend to Handle Insertion (Recommended)
    35→
    36→Keep backend simple. Frontend will:
    37→1. When dropping at position X, shift all questions at positions >= X up by 1
    38→2. Create the new question at position X
    39→3. Update local state with correct ordering
    40→
    41→### Option B: Update Backend to Auto-Shift
    42→
    43→Make backend handle the shift automatically when creating a question at a specific order. More complex but cleaner API.
    44→
    45→---
    46→
    47→## Implementation (Option A)
    48→
    49→### File: `apps/web/src/components/survey-builder/index.tsx`
    50→
    51→Update the palette drop handler in `handleDragEnd`:
    52→
    53→```tsx
    54→// Handle palette drop on a specific question (insert before it)
    55→if (active.data.current?.questionType && over.id !== "canvas") {
    56→    const questionType = active.data.current.questionType as Question["type"];
    57→    const targetIndex = questions.findIndex((q) => q.id === over.id);
    58→
    59→    if (targetIndex !== -1) {
    60→        // 1. Shift existing questions at positions >= targetIndex up by 1
    61→        const shiftedQuestions = questions.map((q, index) => ({
    62→            ...q,
    63→            order: index >= targetIndex ? index + 1 : index,
    64→        }));
    65→
    66→        // 2. Create the new question at targetIndex
    67→        const newQuestion = {
    68→            surveyId: survey.id,
    69→            type: questionType,
    70→            title: `New ${questionTypeLabels[questionType] || questionType}`,
    71→            order: targetIndex,
    72→        };
    73→
    74→        // 3. Update local state immediately (optimistic)
    75→        const optimisticNewQuestion = {
    76→            id: `temp_${Date.now()}`,
    77→            ...newQuestion,
    78→        };
    79→        const newQuestions = [
    80→            ...shiftedQuestions.slice(0, targetIndex),
    81→            optimisticNewQuestion,
    82→            ...shiftedQuestions.slice(targetIndex),
    83→        ];
    84→        setQuestions(newQuestions);
    85→
    86→        // 4. Create on backend
    87→        createMutation.mutate(newQuestion, {
    88→            onSuccess: (created) => {
    89→                // Replace temp with real question
    90→                setQuestions(prev => prev.map(q =>
    91→                    q.id === optimisticNewQuestion.id ? created : q
    92→                ));
    93→                // Also update all shifted questions on backend
    94→                reorderMutation.mutate({
    95→                    questions: shiftedQuestions.map(q => ({ id: q.id, order: q.order })),
    96→                });
    97→            },
    98→        });
    99→    }
   100→    return;
   101→}
   102→```
   103→
   104→### Simplified Implementation
   105→
   106→Actually, a simpler approach: after creating the question, call reorder with the complete new order:
   107→
   108→```tsx
   109→// Handle palette drop on a specific question (insert before it)
   110→if (active.data.current?.questionType && over.id !== "canvas") {
   111→    const questionType = active.data.current.questionType as Question["type"];
   112→    const targetIndex = questions.findIndex((q) => q.id === over.id);
   113→
   114→    if (targetIndex !== -1) {
   115→        createMutation.mutate(
   116→            {
   117→                surveyId: survey.id,
   118→                type: questionType,
   119→                title: `New ${questionTypeLabels[questionType] || questionType}`,
   120→                order: targetIndex,
   121→            },
   122→            {
   123→                onSuccess: (newQuestion) => {
   124→                    // Build the new array with correct order
   125→                    const reorderedQuestions = [
   126→                        ...questions.slice(0, targetIndex).map((q, i) => ({ ...q, order: i })),
   127→                        { ...newQuestion, order: targetIndex },
   128→                        ...questions.slice(targetIndex).map((q, i) => ({ ...q, order: targetIndex + 1 + i })),
   129→                    ];
   130→
   131→                    setQuestions(reorderedQuestions);
   132→                    setSelectedQuestionId(newQuestion.id);
   133→                    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["question"] });
   134→
   135→                    // Reorder all questions on backend
   136→                    reorderMutation.mutate({
   137→                        questions: reorderedQuestions.map(q => ({ id: q.id, order: q.order })),
   138→                    });
   139→
   140→                    toast.success("Question added");
   141→                },
   142→            },
   143→        );
   144→    }
   145→    return;
   146→}
   147→```
   148→
   149→---
   150→
   151→## Critical Files
   152→- `apps/web/src/components/survey-builder/index.tsx` - Fix `handleDragEnd` and `onSuccess` callback
   153→
   154→---
   155→
   156→## Verification
   157→- [ ] Drag from palette to question 2 (index 1) → new question appears at position 1
   158→- [ ] Existing questions after position 1 are shifted down
   159→- [ ] Drop indicator shows at correct position while dragging
   160→- [ ] Backend reflects correct order after drop
